fields.label: 0x00482900: takes 2 args, not 0 — __ftol hides an ST0 input
fields.value: Plate and hooks.csv both said `int f(void)` with FUN_004a2c48 as a 'frame count getter'. Both false: it is __ftol (already C3), which takes its input in ST0, so Ghidra reported the whole function void-parameter. Real body: (int)(param_1 * 60.0f / param_2) * 36 + 412. A port from the old plate would have been int f(void) calling a getter that does not exist.

fields.label: 0x004a2b60 is MSVC sprintf — never a port target
fields.value: Spec'd SPEC_COMPLETE by a brief. It builds a fake FILE on the stack and calls _output, and sits inside the FidDB band msvc-crt-main marked 'do NOT promote'. A brief asks whether a function can be TESTED, never whether it should be PORTED. orch_rank_gate.py now applies a LIBRARY_BANDS filter that overrides any brief verdict.

fields.label: The two defects compounded
fields.value: The off-quota screen launched this run read the stale 0x00482900 plate and returned it as the ONLY READY row, picking a ZERO-ARG arg_type. That would not merely have been a bad port — with no args pushed, both sides read the same stack garbage and return the same value, i.e. a bit-identical FALSE GREEN the non-degeneracy check cannot catch.
